Hydrocodone Happiness
I've been taking hydrocodones for 5 years now and each time the experience is equally as wonderful. Unlike heroin I don't have to chase the high because I get the same high each time. Hell right now I just took 2 of the 10/650's and I feel excellent.
When I take hydrocodones I don't get drowsy or disoriented, I actually get more of a 'speed' feeling. It gives me energy almost like cocaine but with a disassociated feeling along with it.
